issue.title: Router doens't match with an route

system_prompt: You are a helpful AI assistant who classifies GitHub issues according to predefined categories. Your goal is to determine if the GitHub issue can be reproduced to verify the provided solution's correctness.
llm_response:
CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This is a conceptual issue with Express.js routing that can be analyzed without needing to build or run the code. The problem is in the order of route definitions. In Express, routes are matched in the order they are defined. In the provided code, the root route handler `app.use('/', ...)` is defined before the endpoint router `app.use('/endpoint', endpointRouter)`. This means all requests will first try to match with the root route, and since `app.use('/', ...)` will match any path starting with '/', it captures all requests including '/endpoint/something'. The solution is simply to reorder the routes, putting the more specific route first. This is a common Express.js pattern that can be verified through code analysis without needing to build or run the application.
